d:ScenarioDef/HH_Scen_HarborTown.label: Harbor Town
d:ScenarioDef/HH_Scen_HarborTown.descrip:
Three friends inherit a weathered roadside inn above a quiet natural harbour, right where the trade caravans pass. The roof leaks, the sign fell down years ago and the beds are bare - but the road is busy, the water is clear and the neighbours are friendly.

Build it back up: a few guest beds first, then a tavern and a market, and one day a whole little town that people travel to see.

A bright, gentle start for Hearth & Harbor. Pairs well with Hetty Hearthwell, the storyteller who likes builders.
d:ScenarioDef/HH_Scen_HarborTown.scenari: Reopen an old inn by the harbour and grow it into a town people travel to see. A bright tourism start.
d:ScenarioDef/HH_Scen_BackRoom.label: The Back Room
d:ScenarioDef/HH_Scen_BackRoom.descripti:
Your waystation on the old smugglers' road is failing. Then the debts are bought - quietly, all of them - by the Black Ledger. They do not want the money back. Not yet. They want the room behind the kitchen, a table with no questions, and a host who looks the other way.

The underworld already knows your name. Make it rich, make it fear you, or make it go away.

A dark, morally grey start for the shady side of Hearth & Harbor: back room, fence, drug lounge, fight pit and an account at a bank that never forgets.
A failing waystation in debt to the Black Ledger, with the underworld already at the door. A dark, shady start.
